candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner check require to allow anyone to call sendTo (remove owner restriction).
Change transfer to send (using .send) which returns a boolean instead of reverting on failure.
Reverse the order of checks: perform amount > 0 check before owner check (may expose different revert conditions).
Insert a check preventing the owner from calling sendTo (negate owner equality).
Change the zero-address check to allow zero address (remove the require), enabling transfers to address(0).
